Usage:
  ghcp-delegate [options] "<task>"        |   printf '%s' "<task>" | ghcp-delegate [options] -
    -t, --tier <flash|flash-lo|pro>   tier (default: option default_tier, else flash)
    -m, --model <id|auto|fusion>      exact Copilot model; overrides tier mapping
        --fusion <level|profile>      use Copilot Fusion: --model fusion --auto-tier <profile>, where level
                                      standard = hydrafusion, max = hydrafusion-max (high: exit 1, no profile
                                      of its own); any other value is sent as the profile id
        --auto-tier <profile>         Auto/Fusion routing profile id, sent as given (only with model auto or fusion)
        --effort <level>              reasoning effort; dropped (with a stderr note) when model=auto or fusion
    -d, --dir <path>                  first --dir = working dir (-C); later --dir => --add-dir. Default $PWD
        --add-dir <path>              extra allowed dir (repeatable)
    Permissions (default profile: READ-ONLY):
        --write                       allow file edit/create tools (--allow-tool write)
        --allow-shell <pattern>       allow one shell command pattern, e.g. 'npm test', 'git:*' (repeatable)
        --web                         allow all URLs (--allow-all-urls)
        --allow-url <host|url>        allow one URL/host (repeatable)
        --github                      keep built-in GitHub MCP server and allow its tools
        --yolo                        --allow-all-tools (all tools incl. any shell; path checks stay on)
        --all-paths                   --allow-all-paths (only valid together with --yolo)
        --sandbox                     run shell tools in Copilot's MXC sandbox (host prerequisites!)
    Session:
    -c, --continue                    resume most recent Copilot session
        --resume <id>                 resume a specific session
        --name <name>                 name the new session
    Time / output:
        --timeout <dur>               wall clock, e.g. 300s, 10m (default option timeout, else 10m)
        --digest                      append the digest output contract
        --share <path>                write the session transcript markdown to <path>
        --print-command               print the resolved copilot argv (shell-quoted, one line) and exit 0
    -h, --help

Exit codes:
  0 ok | 1 usage error | 2 COPILOT_FAILED | 3 EMPTY_OUTPUT | 10 QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
  11 AUTH_REQUIRED | 12 TIMEOUT | 13 COPILOT_MISSING | 14 MODEL_UNAVAILABLE / FUSION_UNAVAILABLE
  15 PERMISSION_DENIED | 16 SANDBOX_BLOCKED (Claude Code's Bash sandbox blocks Copilot)
  130 interrupted (INT/TERM/HUP forwarded to Copilot; GHCP_SIGNAL status CANCELLED)

Output: stdout = Copilot's final answer only (also on exit 12/15 when present).
  stderr = GHCP_SESSION <id>, GHCP_FALLBACK {...}, GHCP_DENIED {...}, GHCP_NOTE {...},
  GHCP_USAGE {...}, GHCP_SIGNAL {...} (exit >= 2) plus notes. Set GHCP_USAGE_LOG (or option
  usage_log) to also append the GHCP_USAGE / GHCP_SIGNAL lines, timestamped, to a file.

Copilot Fusion: a run with model fusion or an --auto-tier profile gets COPILOT_CLI_ENABLED_FEATURE_FLAGS
  (undocumented internal Copilot CLI feature flags that headless Fusion needs) = any value already set
  plus option fusion_feature_flags (default DYNAMIC_AUTO_TIERS,HYDRAFUSION_PLAN_V2; empty = off).
  When Copilot refuses Fusion before any model call (no dynamic Auto tiers, a missing flag, a profile
  id not offered), the wrapper re-runs once on plain auto, which is billed (option fusion_fallback).
